historical_run.scope_note: First broad historical evidence-map pass; not an exhaustive history of medicine. Future additions require a versioned amendment rather than silent modification.

governing_principles: Historical frequency does not by itself create a scientific criterion.
A candidate criterion is promoted only when it has face validity, scientific coherence, an operational definition, and useful discrimination between successful and failed historical divisions.
Socioeconomic, political, military, technological, institutional, commercial and regulatory factors are controls on discovery and adoption history, not intrinsic evidence of disease ontology.
Ask separately why a division occurred at a historical moment and whether the division was scientifically valid.
No single universal score should force distinct diseases, endotypes, stages and treatment-response states into the same ontology.
Criteria are therefore divided into universal evidence requirements and classification-specific requirements.
Clinical utility can validate an operational classification without establishing a separate biological disease.
Regulatory approval, expert consensus and historical persistence are not sufficient evidence of separate disease ontology.
Treatment response alone is not sufficient evidence of separate disease ontology.
A stage is allowed to change over time; longitudinal transition is evidence for a stage rather than a validity failure.
A treatment-resistance state must be evaluated after adequate exposure and pseudoresistance assessment.
If a downstream disease review identifies a missing criterion, it must return an amendment candidate to the historical module; the disease-specific module cannot edit this frozen framework.

universal_criteria.name: Operationalizable reproducible discriminator
universal_criteria.requirement: The proposed distinction can be recognized with adequate reliability using defined clinical, pathological, biological or other measurements.

universal_criteria.name: Independent replication and transportability
universal_criteria.requirement: The distinction is reproduced in genuinely independent study families, settings, populations or methods appropriate to the claim.

universal_criteria.name: Boundary robustness
universal_criteria.requirement: The distinction is not primarily created by arbitrary thresholds, assay conditions, local measurement practice or unstable symptom dominance. If evidence is continuous, dimensional representation must be considered.

universal_criteria.name: Temporal coherence
universal_criteria.requirement: Timing must fit the proposed class: a distinct pre-existing disease cannot be inferred solely from post-treatment findings; a stage must show longitudinal ordering; a resistance state must follow treatment exposure.

universal_criteria.name: Specificity beyond alternatives
universal_criteria.requirement: The distinction must be evaluated against severity, duration, treatment exposure, adherence, comorbidity, diagnostic error, environmental/social conditions, measurement artefact and other plausible explanations.

universal_criteria.name: Natural-history or longitudinal coherence
universal_criteria.requirement: The proposed class should show a course pattern appropriate to its ontology; absence does not automatically reject a molecular subtype but weakens a claim of separate disease.

universal_criteria.name: Clinical decision utility
universal_criteria.requirement: Determine whether classification improves prevention, prognosis, treatment selection, avoidance of ineffective treatment, trial design or another decision. Utility supports adoption but does not prove ontology.

DISTINCT_DISEASE.additional_gate: At least one strong intrinsic discriminator consistent with D01, preferably supported by D02 and/or U06.

criteria.name: Objective biological test or reproducible pathology

BIOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE_OR_ENDOTYPE.note: Overlap with other subtypes and incomplete membership stability may be compatible with an endotype if the biology is reproducible and clinically meaningful.

DISEASE_STAGE.note: Movement between stages is expected; immutable membership is not required. Biological separators strengthen but are not mandatory for a useful stage classification.

criteria.name: Standardized adequate treatment exposure before resistance assignment

TREATMENT_RESPONSE_STATE.note: An objective resistance assay is ideal when biologically available (for example microbial susceptibility), but absence of such an assay does not invalidate a clinically useful resistance state if exposure and outcome are rigorously established.

criteria.name: Reliable and useful standardization despite absent biological separator

OPERATIONAL_CLINICAL_CATEGORY.note: This category must be explicitly described as operational and must not be promoted to biological ontology by consensus or regulation alone.

historical_context_controls.name: War, political stability, national/global economic conditions
historical_context_controls.use: Explain opportunity, suppression, urgency and timing; never intrinsic disease evidence.

historical_context_controls.name: Research funding, institutional capacity and technology availability
historical_context_controls.use: Control whether the distinction was observable/testable at that time.

historical_context_controls.name: Commercial, reimbursement, advocacy and regulatory incentives
historical_context_controls.use: Control translation/adoption and differential investment across candidate subgroups.

historical_context_controls.name: Prestige, authority, professional structure and institutional competition
historical_context_controls.use: Bias flag for classification creation or persistence independent of evidence.

historical_context_controls.name: Duration/persistence of classification
historical_context_controls.use: Historical observation only; persistence may represent either validity or inertia.

amendment_rule: Any change creates a new framework version. A target disorder must be rerun under the original and amended versions if the amendment could change a central conclusion.
